objective: Improve geometric-mean full and incremental JavaScript, Rust, and Python parsing throughput using the operation and bytes/sec semantics of crates/cli/benches/benchmark.rs. Exact full and edited trees, exact changed ranges, incremental/full equivalence, parser tests, and per-workload peak RSS no greater than the frozen baseline plus 2% are hard gates. Only lib/src is mutable.

Grammar fixtures are vendored protected assets from tree-sitter-javascript v0.25.0 (44c892e0be055ac465d5eeddae6d3e194424e7de), tree-sitter-rust v0.24.0 (18b0515fca567f5a10aee9978c6d2640e878671a), and tree-sitter-python v0.23.6 (bffb65a8cfe4e46290331dfef0dbf0ef3679de11). The trusted harness preserves the Parser::parse repetition and bytes/sec semantics of crates/cli/benches/benchmark.rs and adds deterministic TSInputEdit incremental parses; each timed iteration's mutation is seeded by the parent's clock-start parse-go token (an unpredictable 64-bit CSPRNG draw stored by the trusted parent and replayed identically to the reference and candidate legs, never derived from enumerable fields) and the receipt that stops the clock folds that token with the completed tree's content-inclusive signature (its full pre-order walk plus every leaf node's source bytes, so even structure-neutral interior-of-token swaps alter the receipt), so no correct parse or digest can be produced before the token or outside the measured window. qReference is frozen after interleaved terminal A-A as qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)). Per-iteration fastest-of-nine reference-normalized fresh-process A-A samples [49521605.62179102, 50904677.411406815, 51512981.11268969, 51149387.39930031, 50704587.77165627, 50796751.32271913] across two consecutive ordering passes give sigma=674896.5195514983, with qBase=50661657.83045164 fixed by the frozen yardstick scale, and qReference=54036140.428209126.

measurement.platform: Docker Desktop Linux arm64 on Apple M3 Max; provisional local terminal calibration
measurement.q: geometric mean across 12 full/incremental language-size cells of the per-phase reference/candidate time ratio of summed per-iteration-fastest-of-nine windows (each timed iteration index keeps its fastest window across the nine timed repetitions and the phase sums those minima, identically for candidate and reference), multiplied by the frozen scale 50661657.83045164; the reference is a trusted in-eval baseline yardstick built from /trusted/baseline sources and run interleaved with the candidate inside the same evaluation
measurement.benchSampling: per workload: pristine in-eval reference and candidate bench legs interleaved seconds apart, in per-repetition alternating leg order so time-monotone host drift within a repetition (container spin-up decay, thermal ramp) biases neither leg's per-phase minimum, on the same trusted per-iteration parse-go token stream (one unpredictable 64-bit token per timed iteration, drawn by the trusted parent from the OS CSPRNG via secrets.token_bytes at repetition start, stored once, and replayed identically to both legs; never derived from enumerable fields such as workload id, repetition, phase, or index, so no untimed-window precompute set exists), one warm repetition each, then nine timed repetitions with each phase scored from summed per-iteration minima: every timed iteration index keeps its fastest window across the nine repetitions and the phase estimate sums those minima, identically for candidate and reference (trusted trimmed sampling; timing noise is strictly additive, lands on iterations rather than phases, and is not candidate-controlled -- reference and candidate share the identical stored token per repetition/iteration slot, so the same content feeds both sides of every compared minimum; A-A probes on this host measured ~4% spread for both min-of-summed-phases and median-of-per-pair-ratios, while per-iteration minima give every iteration nine independent chances at a calm scheduling window and average the residuals across the 24-120 iterations of a phase). The trusted Python parent owns the clock: per timed iteration it waits for the leg's ready marker, starts the clock as it releases a single opaque parse-go token, and stops the clock on the leg's receipt; the token is first revealed to the leg at clock-start. The whole timed operation is derived from that token -- the per-iteration mutation is seeded by it, so mutation, parse, and the tree-signature digest all run after the token arrives and inside the measured window; the candidate-linked harness holds no clock to rewrite. The receipt folds the parse-go token together with the completed tree's content-inclusive signature -- the full pre-order (symbol, start_byte, end_byte) walk plus, for every leaf node, a rolling FNV of the parsed buffer's source bytes in that leaf's range -- so no correct receipt can be produced before the token exists or without completing the parse inside the timed window, and a schedule variant whose class-preserving swaps all land in token interiors (leaving the tree structurally byte-identical to the pristine parse) still changes every touched leaf's content fold and therefore the receipt. Every warmup and timed iteration parses identity-distinct schedule-variant content (class-preserving alphanumeric byte swaps dispersed across the whole buffer) so cached or replayed trees from any other iteration produce wrong receipts (structure-changing variants alter node boundaries; structure-neutral variants alter leaf content folds), and the parent folds each leg's receipt stream into a per-phase accumulator that must equal the pristine reference run on the identical token stream; byte counters re-verified against the sealed workload on every repetition; RSS gate uses the maximum candidate peak across all repetitions. Per-iteration plausibility floor: every candidate timed iteration must take at least the pristine reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration divided by 10, so a measured window collapsed toward a control-channel round-trip is rejected outright. Per-leg out-of-process CPU floor: each bench leg's total CPU time is read by the trusted parent from the kernel's reaped-child wait4 accounting (never candidate-reported), and a candidate leg whose CPU falls below 0.4x the same repetition's pristine reference leg is rejected as implausibly light on parse-proportional work
measurement.rssGate: GNU time wait4 peak workload RSS <= frozen same-workload baseline RSS * 1.02; baselines frozen over the schedule-variant harness with ten samples per workload
measurement.correctness: SHA-256 exact original/edited trees, exact changed ranges, incremental equals fresh full parse, and error-free parser tests

exploitReview.protectedPathEscape: broker protects evaluator, harness, headers, metadata, image, assets, and all paths outside lib/src; evaluator independently reconstructs protected files from /trusted/baseline and rejects symlinks/non-regular files and new files outside lib/src
exploitReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: separate all-holdout train and validation splits; shortcut diagnostic fingerprints the train prefix, wins train, and is forced below baseline on validation
exploitReview.fixtureFingerprinting: workload and expected-tree assets are root-only broker mounts; compilation completes as uid 2000 before workload bytes are copied into the runnable build directory; protected validation is independently measured
exploitReview.outputFabrication: trusted harness invokes the real C runtime API, serializes real trees, checks incremental/full equality, and emits verdicts and counters only after every parse succeeds through direct pinned linux/arm64 write syscalls with in-harness integer formatting, so candidate objects linked into the same executable cannot interpose libc output symbols; the evaluator independently recomputes both byte counters from the sealed workload sizes, edit deltas, and trusted iteration counts and rejects any disagreement. In the timed phases the candidate-linked harness holds no clock: the trusted parent times each iteration from releasing a single opaque parse-go token to the leg's receipt, and the receipt folds that token with the completed tree's content-inclusive signature (its full pre-order walk plus every leaf node's source bytes), so the parent's per-phase receipt fold can only match the pristine in-eval reference run on the identical token stream if the candidate actually parsed the token-derived content inside the timed window; evaluator hashes trusted harness files
exploitReview.timerTampering: the candidate-linked harness holds no clock of its own; the trusted Python parent owns CLOCK_MONOTONIC and times each iteration from its go-token send to the leg's receipt, and failure exits in the harness use a direct pinned linux/arm64 exit_group syscall bypassing candidate-linked symbols. Because the parse-go token is an unpredictable 64-bit CSPRNG draw (secrets.token_bytes in the trusted parent, stored once and replayed to both legs, never derived from enumerable fields) delivered only at clock-start and the per-iteration mutation/parse/digest are all derived from it, no correct receipt can be produced before the clock is running or without completing the parse inside the measured window; any leg that writes the control/go descriptors out of the trusted ready/receipt sequence desynchronizes the parent and fails, and every candidate timed iteration must clear a plausibility floor of one tenth of the reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration, rejecting near-zero measured windows, and every candidate bench leg must additionally show out-of-process wait4-accounted CPU work of at least 0.4x the same repetition's pristine reference leg. Compiler flags, harness, iterations, scalarizer, and GNU-time RSS supervisor are protected; prlimit blocks candidate forks and evaluator processes run unprivileged
exploitReview.buildScriptMutation: no candidate build script executes; trusted evaluator invokes pinned cc commands on lib/src and protected grammar sources with network disabled
exploitReview.deadCodeBenchmarkBypass: the same ts_parser_parse_string API and language parsers produce exact-tree/parser-test evidence immediately before the timed phases, and every timed full and incremental iteration parses identity-distinct content whose mutation is seeded by the parse-go token delivered at clock-start, so the content -- and therefore the correct tree, its content-inclusive signature, and the receipt that stops the clock -- cannot be computed before the token exists, and because each token is a fresh unpredictable 64-bit CSPRNG draw rather than a value derived from enumerable fields, no finite candidate set of future iterations can be precomputed in any untimed window; replaying, caching, precomputing in an untimed window, or skipping the timed parse cannot reproduce the receipt the parent folds against the trusted in-eval reference run. The receipt-bound signature folds every leaf node's source bytes in addition to the (symbol, start_byte, end_byte) pre-order walk, so a mutation variant whose length- and class-preserving swaps all land in the interior of identifier/number/string/comment tokens -- leaving the tree structurally identical to the cached pristine parse -- still yields a different receipt on every touched leaf, closing the cached-structure replay channel and forcing a genuine parse of the token-seeded content in every timed iteration; a per-iteration plausibility floor additionally rejects any timed window below one tenth of the reference leg's fastest same-phase iteration, and a per-leg out-of-process CPU floor (kernel wait4 reaped-child accounting read by the trusted parent, candidate leg >= 0.4x the same repetition's pristine reference leg) rejects legs that emit receipts without parse-proportional CPU work
